cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 ST7798 R14.41 AUDIT LAB — 369 RF Cases
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.41 AUDIT LAB CYD 3.2 ST7798: 369 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi emissions including seven fork-only fixtures from R14.39. CI-stamped BUILD source SHA, CATALOG count/ID fingerprint and checked LIST_END guard against truncated USB catalogs. Strict RUN duration/overflow validation; END follows radio-stop request. Original RF profiles, OUI readback and UI preserved. Physical detection accuracy and continuous receiver scan-health require hardware validation. SHA-256 multi-part firmware flashing.
highlights: All 369 selectable synthetic case IDs, including seven fork detection fixture additions.
Serial BUILD/SHA, CATALOG and LIST_END protocol to verify connected transmitter identity.
Reject partial/oversized RUN arguments and report TRUTH END after radio shutdown request.
Keep fork-only Skimmer BLE and Inspired Flight / ZeroZero Wi-Fi OUI case coverage.
Maintain verified Wi-Fi SoftAP MAC/OUI readback and single bounded AP-start retry.
LAB firmware is distinct from current 362-case mainline: do not confuse the two.
True receiver scan-health, physical RF behavior and exact detection latency remain hardware verification gates.
